notes.body:
added 1 commit
  • efef499e - Address more warnings from check_typed_item_calls.py
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/10122/diffs?diff_id=636490913&start_sha=3e9f51bf55f5bd6cff06c6f050fa2e51243028ec)

added 2 commits
  • 512a1ca2 - 1 commit from branch wireshark:master
  • 1a290601 - Address more warnings from check_typed_item_calls.py
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/10122/diffs?diff_id=636577348&start_sha=efef499efff0f70842c62c0034bb14d430f2c899)
enabled an automatic merge when the pipeline for 1a29060159f3bce671bb8ef1d489b5b3fb76cb1f succeeds
I regenerated both of these.  I wonder if its worth scripting a check that generated dissectors and newer than the input files..
